title: Riemann Converter Grade Covariance and Prime-Staircase Compatibility

converter_specification.displayed_formula: T_{sigma,t}(x) = Re( sum_{n=1}^infty (mu(n)/n) * int_{-infty + i*t*log(x)/n}^{(sigma + i*t)*log(x)/n} (e^z / z) dz )
converter_specification.standard_notation_formula: T_{sigma,t}(x) = Re( sum_{n=1}^infty (mu(n)/n) * Ei((sigma + i*t)*log(x)/n) ) = Re( sum_{n=1}^infty (mu(n)/n) * Li(x^{(sigma + i*t)/n}) )
converter_specification.branch_and_path_convention: Principal branch of exponential integral Ei(z) with branch cut on negative real axis (-infty, 0]; the lower contour endpoint -infty + i*t*log(x)/n defines the standard horizontal integration contour avoiding the branch cut for t != 0.
converter_specification.mathematical_source: Bernhard Riemann (1859), 'Ueber die Anzahl der Primzahlen unter einer gegebenen Groesse', combined with Mobius inversion connecting prime-power counting J(x) to prime counting pi(x).
converter_specification.component_identity: Single-frequency Mobius-inverted Riemann/Gram harmonic building block of the prime-counting function pi(x). When summed over nontrivial zero pairs rho and combined with the Li(x) trend, it reconstructs the prime staircase.

scale_covariance_theorem.statement: For any real scale c > 0, complex frequency s = sigma + i*t, and coordinate x > 1: T_{c*sigma, c*t}(x^{1/c}) = T_{sigma,t}(x)
scale_covariance_theorem.proof_mechanism: Under coordinate transformation (s, log x) |-> (c*s, c^{-1}*log x), the upper integration limit (c*s)*log(x^{1/c})/n = s*log(x)/n and lower contour height (c*t)*log(x^{1/c})/n = t*log(x)/n are identically invariant for every term n >= 1. The Mobius factor mu(n)/n is unaltered.
scale_covariance_theorem.tc_specialization: T_{tau^K*sigma, tau^K*t}(x^{tau^{-K}}) = T_{sigma,t}(x) for tau = 2*pi and K in A_R
scale_covariance_theorem.generic_base_control: GENERIC_CONVERTER_SCALE_COVARIANCE: Identity holds identically for every positive real base b > 0 and scale factor c > 0. It is a fundamental conformal invariance of the logarithmic integral Li(x^s), not a tau-specific RH mechanism.

prime_side_zeta_pushforward.staircase_jump_locations: Jumps occur at x = p^{tau^{-K}} for primes p, with exact integer height increment Delta pi_K = 1

prime_embeddings_comparison.analytic_embedding: A_K(p) = p^{tau^{-K}} with log A_K(p) = tau^{-K} * log p (dilation)
prime_embeddings_comparison.arithmetic_realization: G_K(p) = p * tau^K with log G_K(p) = log p + K * log(tau) (translation)
prime_embeddings_comparison.geometry_distinction: Dilation u |-> tau^{-K}*u on R vs Translation u |-> u + K*log(tau) on R; these generate the affine group Aff_+(R) and do NOT commute for K != 0

arithmetic_status.G_K_p: Transcendental for all rational K != 0 by Lindemann (1882), since p in Q_bar^x and tau^K is transcendental
arithmetic_status.A_K_p: OPEN_TRANSCENDENCE_STATUS: p^{tau^{-K}} is an algebraic number raised to a transcendental exponent; Gelfond-Schneider does NOT apply to transcendental exponents

interpretation_A_horizontal.definition: pi_K^{horiz}(x) = pi(x / tau^K) with jumps at x = p * tau^K
interpretation_A_horizontal.mellin_transform: tau^{-Ks} * P(s), corresponding to arithmetic grid dilation D_K[zeta](s) = tau^{-Ks} * zeta(s)

interpretation_B_vertical.definition: pi_K^{vert}(x) = tau^K * pi(x) with jumps at native p and scaled height tau^K
interpretation_B_vertical.mellin_transform: tau^K * P(s), a global scalar multiple

interpretation_C_abstract_graded.definition: pi_K^{graded}(x) = pi(x) with formal grade labels (K, n) in M_tau projecting to native referents under M_tau / U_grade =~ Z_{!=0}
interpretation_C_abstract_graded.mellin_transform: Native zeta Dirichlet series with formal grade unit twist chi_s(u_K) = tau^{-Ks}

staircase_interpretations_audit.canonical_selection: Interpretation A reflects physical grid translation; Interpretation C reflects abstract monoid referents. Neither coincides with the analytic converter staircase N(x^{tau^K}).

centered_harmonic_and_defect.centered_harmonic: H_rho(x) = x^{rho - 1/2} = e^{w_rho * log x} with |H_rho(x)| = x^delta
centered_harmonic_and_defect.analytic_action: w |-> tau^K * w, x |-> x^{tau^{-K}} ==> H_{rho,K}(x_K) = H_rho(x) identically invariant (|H_K| = x^delta)
centered_harmonic_and_defect.arithmetic_action: x |-> tau^K * x ==> H_rho(tau^K * x) = tau^{K * w_rho} * H_rho(x) with modulus |H_rho(tau^K * x)| = tau^{K * delta} * |H_rho(x)|
centered_harmonic_and_defect.defect_derivation_provenance: The canonical TC non-unitarity defect B_rho(K) is derived directly from the contrast between converter-invariant analytic scaling and arithmetic linear grade realization.

intrinsic_prime_referent_audit.multi_prime_rigidity_proof: If p_1^{tau^{-K}(rho-1/2)} = tau^{K(rho-1/2)} * p_1^{rho-1/2} and p_2^{tau^{-K}(rho-1/2)} = tau^{K(rho-1/2)} * p_2^{rho-1/2} for rho != 1/2, then (tau^{-K} - 1)*log(p_1) = (tau^{-K} - 1)*log(p_2) = K*log(tau), forcing log(p_1) = log(p_2) and p_1 = p_2. Thus coincidence on multiple primes is strictly refuted.

conclusions.why_tuning_survives: The Riemann Converter tunes logarithmic coordinates to prime powers via the dimensionless combination s*log(x). Reciprocal scaling (s, log x) |-> (c*s, c^{-1}*log x) preserves every phase and amplitude exactly.
conclusions.why_arithmetic_grid_does_not_constrain: The arithmetic grid realization x |-> tau^K * x translates log-space (u |-> u + K*log(tau)) rather than dilating it (u |-> tau^{-K}*u). It alters the harmonic modulus by tau^{K*delta}. However, no intrinsic prime-referent identity forces the converter to equal its translated counterpart on physical coordinates.
conclusions.earliest_missing_bridge: Construct an authentic arithmetic functional or boundary condition that directly forces the physical prime stations to obey the translation group action without breaking the conformal scaling of the explicit formula.
